attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The same day keeps the translation of the relics of George the Great Martyr and the dedication of his church at Lydda, which is a feast and not this man; nothing on either page connects the two beyond the name. The Neapolis of his epithet is the one in Asia Minor, «που τούρκικα λέγεται Νέβ Σεχήρ», and the corpus keeps no George of it. No location is recorded even so, because the page's places are a parish, a road and two churches rather than a seat. It records his relic incorrupt in the church of Saint Eustathios at Perissos in Attica, where it was taken in 1924. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
